note: How the F11 Map page's globe looks (src/ui/globe_view.gd). Each pin kind is a small shape (star, triangle, square, diamond, cross, circle, ring, planet, cruiser) in a colour; 'planet' and 'cruiser' are the icons beside the off-planet places; 'ink' is the globe's own lines (null = the player's HUD colour). 'player' is you (a pulsing triangle that points the way you look); 'goal' is the waypoint's colour: the pin it is at flashes, and out where no pin is it shows as its own marker. Names and what goes on the map: content/core/flow/map.json.
